description: Defines the Http2FrameBuilder class used for constructing wire-format HTTP/2 frames, primarily for testing purposes. Includes methods for appending data, setting payloads, and manipulating frame contents.

classes.name: Http2FrameBuilder
classes.description: A class for building HTTP/2 frames in wire format, mainly used in tests.

methods.name: Http2FrameBuilder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the frame builder with frame type, flags, and stream ID or header.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the current size of the buffer.

methods.name: buffer
methods.description: Returns the current buffer containing the frame data.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends a string view to the buffer.

methods.name: AppendBytes
methods.description: Appends raw bytes to the buffer.

methods.name: AppendBytes (template)
methods.description: Appends an array of type T to the buffer.

methods.name: Append (enum methods)
methods.description: Appends enum values for error codes, frame types, and settings parameters.

methods.name: WriteAt
methods.description: Writes data at a specific offset in the buffer.

methods.name: WriteBytesAt
methods.description: Writes raw bytes at a specific offset.

methods.name: WriteUInt24At
methods.description: Writes a 24-bit unsigned integer at a specific offset.

methods.name: SetPayloadLength (overload)
methods.description: Sets payload length based on current buffer size minus header.
